summary.en: The Burkina Faso junta has reinstated the death penalty for terrorism, treason and high crimes, while its army and Russian mercenaries are implicated in new civilian killings, including the discovery of 54 bodies in Tagadayat. In Nigeria, gunmen on motorcycles killed at least 20 people in a village and separate gunmen killed at least 10 people in eastern Nigeria. Suspected bandits killed 37 people in a Taraba border community. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: War in the Sahel
background.extract: The War in the Sahel, also known synonymously as the Sahel War is a multi-sided armed conflict that has been ongoing since 2012. In particular, the intensive conflict mainly takes place in the three countries of Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso.
